files.private_content_before:
= Pod Security Best Practices

Containers must not run as root.

Use read-only root filesystems.
files.private_content_after:
= Pod Security Best Practices

Containers must not run as root.

Use read-only root filesystems.

All pods should define a SecurityContext with runAsNonRoot: true.

Pod security admission should enforce the restricted profile for production namespaces.

files.private_content_before:
= Networking Best Practices

Applications should support IPv6 natively.

Use NetworkPolicies to restrict traffic.
files.private_content_after:
= Networking Best Practices

Applications should support IPv6 natively.

Use NetworkPolicies to restrict traffic.

All secondary interfaces (MULTUS) must support dual stack.

Vendors must work with ACME Corp to generate network policies using the internal template. Policies must be deployed through ACME Corp systems.

Services should prefer ClusterIP type unless external access is required. Use Ingress or Gateway API for HTTP routing.

= Observability Best Practices

Applications must expose Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoints.

Use structured logging (JSON format) for all application logs.

CNFs must use the ACME Corp standardized log generation, storage and retrieval means.

Distributed tracing should use OpenTelemetry for instrumentation.
